activities.name: Yoga
activities.whatToBring: Workout clothes, water bottle, mat if you have one
activities.description: Start the day with a group yoga session, Wednesday and Thursday mornings.

activities.name: Running
activities.description: Group run for all paces, Wednesday and Thursday mornings.

activities.name: Golf — 18-Hole Round
activities.whatToBring: Golf attire; bring or rent your own clubs
activities.description: 18-hole round at the hotel's own golf course, tee-off at 10:00. ~€54pp, price varies with demand, buggy not included. No participant limit, valid golf licence required. Payment required to confirm; clubs not provided. Contact Roland Stengele or Marcos Martinez in advance to book.

activities.name: Golf Clinic
activities.whatToBring: Golf attire; clubs & equipment provided by the hotel
activities.description: Beginner-friendly clinic at the hotel's own golf course for those who want to try golf for the first time — 90 min, no previous experience needed. €35pp, min 6 / max 30 participants (larger groups split). Fixed price, advance booking required. Contact Roland Stengele or Marcos Martinez in advance to book.
